profiles.name: Duskling
speciesTraits: Medium Fey with the Incarnum subtype. +2 Constitution, −2 Intelligence. Base land speed 30 ft. Low-light vision doubles human range with color and detail.

Effects that specifically target humanoids, such as charm person, cannot target a Duskling. The species chooses a fixed home plane at character creation with DM approval. On the Material Plane it has the Extraplanar subtype.
The Incarnum subtype marks eligibility for targeted effects. The permanent racial essentia pool increases by 1, or starts at 1 if the character has no other source.
Racial movement gives a +5-ft. enhancement bonus to land speed per invested essentia. It applies with light or no armor and a light load.
Reallocate essentia among the eligible investments as a swift action on your turn. Pool size and the capacity of each investment are separate.
Normal capacity per investment is 1 at character levels 1–5, 2 at 6–11, 3 at 12–17, and 4 at 18–20.

Common and Sylvan are automatic. Bonus languages are Elf (the book’s name for Elven), Gnoll, Gnome, Goblin, and Halfling. Favored class Totemist. The published examples list LA +0 and use class Hit Dice.

The optional 1st-level Duskling Barbarian substitution uses a d10 Hit Die. Incarnum Speed replaces Fast Movement. Each invested point gives +10 ft. enhancement to base land speed with up to medium armor and load and +2 insight on initiative checks. The two enhancement bonuses to speed do not stack.

The optional d10 Barbarian substitutions at 7th and 11th level grant Incarnum Defense and Incarnum Rage respectively. Defense replaces Barbarian damage reduction and gives DR 1/— plus resistance 1 to each energy type per point. Incarnum Rage replaces Greater Rage and grants 2 essentia during rage. Greater Rage then replaces Mighty Rage if reached.

npcBuilds.name: Iriavel Solthenar

build.title: Duskling ropeway guide, Totemist 1
skills: Jump +4 or +6 with 1 essentia in landshark boots
traits: Studded leather +3 and Dexterity +2. Touch 12, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple +1. Fortitude +5, Reflex +4, Will +1. Armor check penalty −1.

Two essentia, one racial and one from Totemist. Capacity 1 per investment. Meldshaper level 1. Shapes two unbound melds, blink shirt and landshark boots. Wild Empathy +1. Alertness adds +2 to Listen and Spot. Class illiteracy applies.
Default allocation is 1 essentia in racial speed and 1 in blink shirt, giving 35-ft. movement and a 20-ft. teleport.
Racial movement gives a +5-ft. enhancement bonus to land speed per invested essentia. It applies with light or no armor and a light load.
Reallocate essentia among the eligible investments as a swift action on your turn. Pool size and the capacity of each investment are separate.
actions: Light crossbow +2 ranged, 1d8 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.
Blink shirt teleports the Totemist alone at will as a standard action. Range is 10 ft. plus 10 ft. per invested essentia. Take no further actions until the next turn.

Landshark boots give +4 competence on Jump, or +6 with 1 essentia. Moving the point from blink shirt to the boots keeps 35-ft. speed, changes teleport range from 20 to 10 ft., and raises Jump from +4 to +6.
build.tactics: Iriavel can take a coil of line across the broken end of a ropeway by jumping or teleporting. He tells the party which span he can cross before asking them to brace the worn anchor.

npcBuilds.motive: Carry a line past the snapped ropeway anchor before the next storm.
npcBuilds.hook: Iriavel can cross the broken span and set a guide rope if the party braces the anchor.

npcBuilds.name: Darevia Thalliar

build.title: Duskling forest corridor watch, Barbarian 1 substitution
skills: Jump +9 at 40 ft., +5 at 30 or 35 ft.
traits: Studded leather +3 and Dexterity +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 13. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fortitude +5, Reflex +1, Will +1. Armor check penalty −1. Class illiteracy applies.

One essentia, invested in Incarnum Speed by default. In light gear it gives 40-ft. speed and initiative +7. Without that investment, base speed is 30 ft. and initiative +5 with Improved Initiative. Moving the point to the racial feature instead gives 35-ft. speed and initiative +5.

The optional 1st-level Duskling Barbarian substitution uses a d10 Hit Die. Incarnum Speed replaces Fast Movement. Each invested point gives +10 ft. enhancement to base land speed with up to medium armor and load and +2 insight on initiative checks. The two enhancement bonuses to speed do not stack.
Reallocate essentia among the eligible investments as a swift action on your turn. Pool size and the capacity of each investment are separate.
actions: Greatclub +3 melee, 1d10+3 bludgeoning, critical ×2, 5-ft. reach. While raging, +5 melee and 1d10+6 damage.
Javelin +2 ranged, 1d6+2 piercing, critical ×2, 30-ft. increment. While raging, 1d6+4 damage.

Ordinary rage once per day, at most once per encounter, up to 8 rounds. While raging, HP 15, AC 12, touch 9, flat-footed 11, grapple +5, Fortitude +7, Reflex +1, Will +3. STR 19, CON 20, Climb +7, and Jump +11 at 40 ft. Remove 2 bonus HP at the end. Fatigue lasts through the encounter with −2 Strength and Dexterity and no running or charging.
build.tactics: Darevia wants a party to escort a delayed family through the forest corridor before it closes at dusk. She keeps a point in Incarnum Speed as she moves between clearings and rages to hold the narrow opening if a creature follows.

npcBuilds.motive: Find a delayed family before the forest corridor closes for the night.
npcBuilds.hook: Darevia can lead the party between clearings and hold the corridor long enough for the family to cross.
